text: {"name":"rf_handle_rx_key_error","confidence":"medium","docstring":"For qualifying received frames, finds the matching interface, checks the transmitter against its peer list, and routes an unknown peer to deauthentication/configuration handling.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"rx_frame","v2":"interface_table_base","v3":"interface_index","i":"interface_record","v6":"interface_offset","v7":"peer_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":38,"meaning":"Peer entry MAC address compared with the received frame's transmitter address"},{"offset":100,"meaning":"Interface MAC address compared with the received frame's destination address"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Interface type or state; this path requires the value 2"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"Interface active flag"},{"offset":240,"meaning":"Head pointer for the interface's peer/key entry list"}]}
